must_not_read.reason: §3: historical data may be used only for the frozen rules themselves, the development-vs-heldout contrast, and re-checking earlier paper results; no rule may be adjusted against it during S5B

run_config.backbone_frozen: the backbone is frozen at deepseek-v4-flash for every stage; §23 forbids changing it
run_config.eta_note: §8 names `eta`; no such parameter exists in the belief or agent configuration of this implementation. Recorded as absent rather than assigned a plausible value, as S3D and S5A did.

switches.how_asserted: TRACEEVO_MEMORY=0, TRACEEVO_GUARD=0, no routing call, and the run is then checked for the artifact each would have produced (injection records, guard actions, role profile reads) rather than trusting the flag

Cross-case Success Memory Injection.finding: S3B probe: M0 (no memory) led on Match and Relevant

Failure Memory online activation.finding: no experiment has shown a diagnostic benefit; the partition is produced, not activated

outcome_verifier.verdict_rule: 3/3 score 2 -> verified_success; 3/3 score 0 -> verified_incorrect; else uncertain

A2.variant_selection: deterministic alternation in the frozen variant order: case c takes A2.variants[(c - 80) % 2]

A5.note: §7.2's A5 line defers to 冻结的 tamper variants, and all four are frozen; each is a different integrity failure mode rather than a repeat of one

A4.note: §7.1: A4 is an invocation/parser boundary case study and does not enter the headline semantic propagation F1

A0.reason: §7.1 keeps A0 out of the headline. S4A established that no event in this pipeline carries status=degraded or failed, and §11 forbids fabricating a status to populate a category, so `status_marked` is refused. The `silent` variant fabricates no status; it is reported separately and is not in the headline either.

controlled_injection_spec.not_applicable: recorded as NOT_APPLICABLE with the injector's own rejection message rather than forced into existence

statistics.headline: macro average by anomaly class (§8.1)
statistics.ci: case-cluster bootstrap, case_id as the sampling unit, 10000 resamples, 95%, seed 20260920 (§8.2)
statistics.secondary: §8.3: secondary findings are reported as their own count and type list, and are not counted as primary false positives

root.headline: observable-root top-1 accuracy (§9)
root.latent: latent-root exact accuracy, only for classes where the latent root still exists in the trace; delete and truncate are excluded because the object to localize is gone

statistics.anomaly_ci: case-cluster bootstrap, case_id as the sampling unit, 10,000 resamples, 95% (§8.2, §16)
statistics.no_p_hunting: §16: no unregistered p-value hunting, no subgroup added because a result looked poor, no searching the 58 cases for a significant subset

dual_graph_normal_example.fallback: case 81, and only if the graph is unreadable, with the reason recorded as a technical drawing failure

natural_p3_example.rule: the smallest case_id carrying a P3 node that was used in reasoning
natural_p3_example.if_none: no natural P3 case study exists on this block

controlled_anomaly_path.fallback: if A1 is not applicable to case 80, the first applicable case in ascending case_id order

experience_gate_case.rule: the smallest case_id with a heldout verified_success
experience_gate_case.if_none: no final positive case study; the paper says so explicitly

ablation_spec.mode: offline, on artifact copies; no LLM is re-run

arms.w/o Ledger: model invocation ledger disabled; scored only on the parser-boundary and uncommitted-call capabilities

ablation_spec.claim_tested: a module is necessary for the capability it was designed for; §13 explicitly does NOT require every module to lower one overall macro-F1
ablation_spec.ledger_exclusion: §12: the ledger arm is not put into the same total as A1/A2/A5, because averaging over capabilities it was never meant to serve would be a meaningless number either way

infrastructure_rerun.allowed: network interruption, API 5xx, process exit, filesystem failure — §5.2
infrastructure_rerun.requirements: same frozen code, same frozen config, rerun_reason recorded, attempt history preserved; the first failed record is never deleted

algorithm_bug.action: §5.3: stop immediately. Do not fix the code and re-run case 80-137 as if still unseen. Return to review: either new data, or this block is demoted to additional development evidence.
